meta.title: Novel Fish
meta.description: Read local novels by actively expanding selected real reasoning steps.

chat.noBook: Select a book in plugin settings first.
chat.switchHint: Book changed. Collapse and actively expand this step again to read.
chat.readError: The passage could not be loaded; progress did not change.
chat.retry: Collapse and actively expand this step to retry.

settings.title: Novel Fish
settings.description: Novel text loads only when a selected real reasoning step is actively expanded. It is never sent to the model.
settings.pickHint: Click one or more real reasoning steps in chat. These are location settings only; they are not bound to novel passages.
settings.pastePlaceholder: Paste novel text with paragraphs, chapter headings, or Markdown headings
settings.emptyLibrary: Import a TXT, MD, EPUB, or pasted text to begin.
settings.notReasoning: Only steps containing reasoning can be selected.
settings.removeConfirm: Delete {title} and its local reading progress?
